_help: Run `python3 scripts/init.py` to fill this in. entities: one object per legal entity: {"code": "DE", "name": "Example GmbH", "folder": "Entity_DE", "currency": "EUR"}. The code is the short label used in registers ("DE: pay the insurance"). not_our_entity: names that contain one of your codes but mean somebody else (a client called "Something DE"). redact_patterns: regular expressions for identity-number formats of your countries; whatever they match is replaced by [redacted] before text is embedded for the shared store.
